Melody Capture lets you recruit wild Digimon by collecting their data as Melodies. Defeat an uninjured foe in one hit, or finish it with a Melody-effect attack. Use its weakness to improve your odds. Hitting its strength lowers them. Turn captured Melodies into Digimon at the DigiLab.
At the DigiLab, you can fuse Digimon to make them stronger and restore captured Melodies to physical form. Ask Veemon by the DigiLab PC for details.
Melody Playback restores a Digimon from its Melody data. The more Melodies you use, the higher its level. You can use up to 10 Melodies at once.
You can turn a Digimon back into a Melody, but this resets all the data you have raised. Be careful!
Expedition teams find all sorts of things, including rare gear and Melodies you cannot get elsewhere.
